features.name: Battery saver (76): read [0], write [1,on], then a later read reported as unconfirmed; YaWei-gated
features.note: A reading after a change cannot be tied to the change (no reply discriminator; the pause is not proof), so it is shown as reported, not stored. A standalone read on a new connection confirms the value. No battery-life gain is claimed.

features.name: Manual blood pressure (69 [2,0])
features.note: Pubu can send 120/80 defaults or stale values when no result arrives. Field meaning unproven; not offered.

features.name: Today's step counter (48) with raw counters and Pubu display convention
features.physical: live via app (integrity4): zero counters received, saved as zero with date/source/unit notes, exported, kept after force-stop and restart (coordinator)
features.note: Date is the phone date at sync. km = distance/1000, kcal = calories/1000 (Pubu convention, not physically validated); raw kept. No accuracy claim.

features.name: Daily totals codec (07)
features.note: Unused alternative in Pubu; daily history comes from quarter-hour records (43), which the app implements.

features.name: Past six days from quarter-hour steps (43), sums calculated on phone
features.automated: header, order, total, late row, raw calorie field and x10 flag
features.note: km = distance/1000 and kcal = calories x flag /1000 follow the Pubu display convention, applied once; raw kept.

features.name: Heart-rate day history (15)
features.note: Stored under the requested day; the watch-returned time value is kept raw, not interpreted.

features.name: Manual heart-rate history list (bulk 28)
features.note: Time = phone date minus watch day offset plus watch minute; recorded in each entry.

features.name: Sleep history (bulk 27): light 2, deep 3, awake 5 as classified by the watch
features.automated: record bounds, summary with unlabelled time and interval mismatch
features.note: Asleep = light + deep. Awake, unlabelled stage time, the stage sum, and the recorded span are shown separately; a mismatch is marked partial or inconsistent. No score. Phone-calculated sums.

features.name: Automatic blood-pressure schedule switch (0C)
features.note: Pubu's switch is real, but its BP results are generated with random terms and age formulas. The app shows no BP results, so the switch is not offered and no BP readings are promised.

features.name: Cycle reminders (2B): user dates, lengths, period/fertile lead days 1-3, reminder time
features.automated: binary layout, lead-day range, no wrap
features.note: Send-only: the watch has no read-back, so the screen says sent, not stored. Day counts are phone calculations. No predictions.

features.name: Local JSON export and delete, with source and calculation notes
features.physical: live SAF export via app, no oxygen keys (coordinator)
features.note: Missing fields stay absent; raw-unit fields are named ...Raw; local write failures are reported, never shown as saved.

features.name: Notification forwarding (72), empty allowlist, dedupe, bounded
features.target: test message displayed (user confirmed, nRF path)
features.physical: 'Hello from P71 Link' sent from the app (connection3) and seen on the watch by the tester; app-to-watch forwarding not tested; notification access not granted
features.note: Non-SMS apps use SMS type 1 with the app name in text. Only type 1 is target-confirmed.

features.name: Calls: incoming CallStyle rings (type 0); answered, cleared, or ended sends type 4; optional reject (11 action 1)
features.automated: state transitions: incoming to ongoing same key, outgoing, unknown, screening, removal, no caller text, ringing update without call type
features.note: Uses notification access and the CallStyle call type; dialers without it are not forwarded (no phone-state or call-log permission). An update of the ringing call that drops its call type clears the ringing. No caller text means a padded control chunk, not invented text. Reject asks for answer-calls permission when turned on. No live call tested.

features.name: Find phone (22): 1 start/restart 10 s alert, 2 stop, others ignored
features.note: No reply is sent, as in the vendor app. Stops on disconnect.

features.name: Remote camera (02)
features.note: The owner asked to leave the camera feature out. No camera screen, permission, or camera command is in the app. Photo backgrounds for faces use the system photo picker and need no camera permission.

features.name: Alarm list (bulk 2C), whole-list write and exact re-read
features.automated: parse/write round trip, byte-identical untouched records, write-echo isolation
features.note: Weekday bit order taken from the vendor editor (bit 0 Sunday). Native capacity and title limit unknown; app limits 10 and 24 bytes.

features.name: Drink reminders, slots 0-7 (read 28, write 27), slot re-read compare
features.automated: raw enable kept, BCD, slot bounds, readback compare
features.note: No capability bit; a slot that does not answer stays unavailable. Raw enable value 2 kept unless switched.

features.name: Move reminder (25 write, 26 read), re-read verified
features.note: Interval values 30/60/90; unit not confirmed and labelled so.

features.name: Contacts (bulk 29), full-list replacement from a phone-side list
features.note: No watch read-back exists; the phone list is the only copy. Uses the system picker, no contacts permission.

features.name: Weather (1A): user-typed place, vendor forecast service, fields forwarded unchanged
features.automated: frame layout, exact-integer boundaries, fraction/overflow rejection
features.note: User-opened network use only. Server numbers must be exact integers in range before conversion; others are left out. Timestamp is an exact long sent as its low 32 bits (meaning unresolved); type codes unlabelled. Service reply not yet seen live.

features.name: Music keys from watch (1D): play/pause, previous, next, volume up/down; opt-in
features.note: No track title, progress, or playing state is sent (1C not used).

features.name: Local music file upload (Jieli SPP path)
features.note: Pubu shows music upload only when music=true; this watch reports false. Not a missing Pubu feature here.
